_comment: W19 S7 (SPEC-94, D19-9): the intact chapters RN and RC are validated on, and where each damage goes. Paragraph indices are into the chapter's paragraphs as pipeline._paragraphs splits its excerpt (pipeline._chapter_body); scene ranges are inclusive; separator paragraphs ('* * *') inside a range are dropped. `change` is the paragraphs where the plan's change happens (cut by planned_change_removed). `rn_scene` is the scene RN reads in every variant: none of its paragraphs is one of the narrator's samples (pipeline.narrator_samples), so RN never scores a sample against itself. Donors are another narrator of the same book (voice_sources), so the cast stays the book's; a `quoted` donor has its frame quotes stripped as narrator_samples does. `dup` copies a paragraph of an earlier scene into a later one: `out` where RC reads it, `in` (trimmed chapters only) inside a trimmed middle. `drift_in` (trimmed chapters only) replaces those paragraphs of the RN scene, all inside its trimmed middle. Plans were written by hand from the text.

plan.title: The stranger on the ice
plan.summary: Locked in the ice, Rowan Merrow's ship rescues a half-frozen stranger from a drifting floe and takes him aboard, where he slowly recovers in Rowan's care.
beats: The ship is locked in ice; a giant on a dog-sledge is seen crossing it
A half-frozen stranger is taken aboard from a drifting floe and slowly recovers
Rowan's admiration and pity for his guest grow
The stranger offers to tell Rowan his story

plan.title: The creature wakes
plan.summary: Emeric Vandel brings his creature to life, recoils in horror and flees from it; his friend Hollis Crane arrives and nurses him through the long nervous fever that follows.
beats: Emeric animates the creature and flees from it in horror
A sleepless night and an aimless walk through the town at dawn
Hollis Crane arrives; Emeric breaks down in hysterical fear
Months of fever under Hollis's care, and a slow recovery

plan.title: A call at Blackmoss Heights
plan.summary: Pembury, the new tenant of Fallowmere Grange, pays a first call on his surly landlord Varrick at Blackmoss Heights, where Varrick's dogs set upon him.
beats: Pembury arrives at the Heights and is grudgingly admitted by Varrick
The farmhouse and its master described
Left alone with the dogs, Pembury is attacked
Varrick grudgingly makes amends, and Pembury resolves to call again

plan.title: The guest at Castle Vasska
plan.summary: Aldous Kerr arrives at Count Vasska's castle as an honoured guest and, after days of courtesy, finds every door locked: the castle is a prison and he is its prisoner.
beats: Aldous reaches the castle at night and the Count welcomes him in
Supper with the Count; his strange appearance; the wolves howl
In the library Aldous and the Count discuss England and the Purfleet estate
The Count casts no reflection; Aldous finds every door locked and knows he is a prisoner

plan.title: The oak closet
plan.summary: Lodged in the forbidden oak closet at Blackmoss Heights, Pembury reads a dead girl's diary and dreams that Rosalind's ghost seizes his hand at the window, begging to be let in.
beats: Pembury shuts himself in the oak closet and reads Rosalind's diary
He dreams of the chapel sermon, then of a ghost-child at the window
His cry brings Varrick, who sends him out and begs the ghost to come in
At dawn Pembury sees the household at breakfast and is guided home through the snow

plan.title: Rosalind's secret
plan.summary: Having accepted Aubrey Penhale, Rosalind confesses to Martha that she loves Varrick as her own being; Varrick, who overheard only that marrying him would degrade her, leaves Blackmoss that night.
beats: Brandon, drunk, threatens Martha and drops Wendell over the banisters; Varrick catches him
Rosalind tells Martha she has accepted Aubrey Penhale
Varrick overhears and steals away; Rosalind declares her love for him and waits for him through the storm
Rosalind falls into a fever, recovers, and marries Aubrey
